title: Evaluation Choices Decide the Winner: code, sealed plans and results
description: Code, sealed analysis plans (SHA-256), partitions and all run-level results for the paper 'Evaluation Choices Decide the Winner: A Pre-Registered Re-Evaluation of Federated Intrusion Detection for Industrial IoT', including the literature audit of 24 federated IDS studies.
